title: Stage 2: agent chat, console notes and forum posts without machine Messages

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deferred from stage 1 (PPY-cd2940): (1) console_web_context SYSTEM turns - the Rust console-chat-responder rebuilds model history from them (main.rs:2344, 2878), so moving the page context into the user turn's metadata.console.webUi is a responder change plus shell UI (papyrus-console-shell.tsx:515, 564, 585, 1022); (2) machine-authored forum posts (coverage_theme forum kickoff/refresh/dispatch/rotating-desk + supersede, Tactus MessageThread.append in tactus_runtime.py/newsroom.py) whose idempotency readers (coverage_theme.py ~2942, 3398, 3958-4046) must move to Edition/Assignment; (3) console chat and the human 'stories note' for agents.
